About Cukurova 
University 
Çukurova University is a state university founded in 1973 in the Adana province of 
Çukurova region, a riverside city located at the southern Mediterranean coast of Türkiye. 
The University has one of the most beautiful campuses of Türkiye, which is located on 
the east coast of the Seyhan Dam Reservoir Lake and is a natural park area. The campus 
complex includes the medico-social unit, housing units, social facilities, guesthouses, 
halls and fields for all sports branches, cafeterias, a printing house and a central library, in 
addition to modern and well-equipped classrooms and lecture halls. Cukurova University 
has more than 45000 students, 2564 academic personnel and 2627 supporting staff. The 
University is renowned for its deep-rooted faculties of agriculture and medicine. Starting 
with only these two faculties, the University currently has 19 faculties, 2 colleges, 11 
vocational schools, 1 state conservatory and 4 institutes.  
Çukurova University is one of 20 Research Universities and 20 universities in the field of 
internationalization in Türkiye. In parallel to its missions as a research and international 
university, Çukurova University has been actively involved in academic and scientific 
cooperation and projects and welcomes international students and visiting fellows.

Credit System ECTS is a learner centered credit system based on the student’s workload. Student 
workload is not only based on the course hour, but the time spent on all other activities 
related to the course including but not limited to the attendance to the course, seminar, 
independent study and exam etc. 
While Cukurova University had been using both local and ECTS credits of the courses as 
a standard of assessment since 2006, it began using only ECTS since 2013-2014 academic 
year. To define student workload, online and paper-based surveys have been 
implemented. Results of the surveys are evaluated under three titles; 
 
1) Lecturer’s performance, 
2) Teaching process (professional contributions of the course to students), 
3) Student workload (inc. course, course preparation, and exam preparation hours). 
 
According to the data retrieved from the surveys, ECTS credits and course programs are 
updated. Accordingly, 1 ECTS credit equals to 25-30 hours workload at our university, 
and it is mandatory that a student must receive 60 ECTS in an academic year. 
 
An example of practice and estimated ECTS procedure at Cukurova University in a 
semester (17 weeks) is similar to the one below; 
 
1 semester= 14 weeks + 1 week mid-term exam + 2 weeks final exam = 30 ECTS 
For more information, please visit: https://ebs.cu.edu.tr/en/general-info/ects-policy/

PRACTICAL INFORMATION 
Visa For all purposes other than touristic and commercial travels, visas must be obtained from 
Turkish Embassies or Consulates in the country of residence. Visa requirements of 
Türkiye in respect of countries can be found on  
http://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa  
 
For general visa information, please visit: 
http://www.mfa.gov.tr/sub.en.mfa?cc4e437c-6769-4d79-9017-10b63c651224  
 
Before applying to Turkish visa, please make sure that the validity of the travel 
document/passport is for at least 6 months as from the date of your arrival in Türkiye. 
The International Office will provide guidance to students in visa related issues including 
also a Visa Letter to facilitate the visa process.  
Residence Permit Foreigners who would stay in Türkiye beyond the duration of a visa or a visa exemption 
or, (in any case) longer than ninety days must obtain a residence permit. The application 
to residence permit is guided by the International Office.

ORIENTATION & CULTURAL ACTIVITIES 
Orientation Program- 
International Office 
Support 
Cukurova University will provide support for the incoming students upon their arrival 
about all academic issues and services, the campus life and student clubs and facilities on 
campus, documents and procedures during their mobility period. Social integration 
activities are usually organized together with ESN (Erasmus Students Network) student 
club. 
Incoming students are required to attend an orientation program during which they will 
receive full information in their welcome pack including information related to academic 
and social programs, accommodation and transportation information sheets, brochures, 
maps, and Turkish culture leaflets. 
 
Cultural Activities The International Office organizes cultural exchange gatherings like welcome and 
farewell dinner, field trips, International Cooking Day as well as visits to open-museums 
and castles, town walks, trekking tours, mountain climbing, sports games, concerts, 
excursions, etc. depending on the group size, weather conditions and academic calendar.  
 
Facilities Cukurova University will provide the incoming students with access to the central library, 
computer laboratories, university cafeteria, housing, sports and medical facilities.  
 
VISITING SCHOLAR PROGRAM 
 Based on its internal regulation related to “Visiting Fellows”, Çukurova University 
welcomes academicians and researchers under four statuses, categorized as follows: 
 Visiting Professors 
 Senior Visiting Fellows (assistant/associate professors) 
 Visiting Fellows (lecturers/post-doc students) 
 Visiting Post-Graduate Candidates (doctoral/master students) 
The visiting scholars and post-graduate candidates are temporarily appointed by the 
University based on the demand of the relevant unit in order to enable them to conduct 
research under the guidance of a faculty member at Cukurova University. 
For more information please visit: 
https://international.cu.edu.tr/cu/internationalization/visiting-scholars/basvuru
